stories.title: 16th Finance Commission retains states' vertical devolution at 41% (2026-31)
stories.body: announced Feb 3; urban local body grants rise 230% to ₹3.56 trillion; ₹1.4 lakh crore announced for states in the budget.

one_liners: 16th Finance Commission retains states' vertical devolution at 41% (2026-31) — announced Feb 3
